text:
Maya: quick sync on routing editor UX — main asks: make priority order obvious to keyboard users, improve validation copy, and stop preview sims from re-running mid-drag. can folks flag blockers? :eyes:
Ravi: initial: drag handle too subtle, no clear drop indicator. recommend 44px handle, darker ghost row, and aria-live text like "Rule moved to position 2".
Claire: copy: replace "limit exceeded" with "You can pin up to 3 rules. Unpin one to add another." For empty preview: "No simulation results 16 try widening filters or add a fallback rule."
Jo: infra constraint: reorders write a new snapshot immediately which cancels running sims. propose snapshot-pin so sims keep results until user refreshes, or debounce snapshot writes by 400ms.
design-bot: a11y checks: focusable handles, aria-live for reorder/errors, contrast fail on pale placeholder.
Maya: action: Ravi -> a11y + microcopy tweaks; Jo -> snapshot-pin/debounce; Claire -> finalize copy. target tiny deploy Thurs. react if picking up. :thumbsup:
